thread:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off a short thread to align on dedicated capacity roadmap priorities for reserved pools, burst, and autoscale. Want to capture launch criteria + negotiated scope for pilot customers. Proposing a 30m sync tomorrow 11am PT. @ajay @carmen @pete please drop must-haves / hard constraints before the sync.

ajay: 11am works for me. must-have: per-tenant burst credits (token-bucket style) and global spillover disabled by default. customers want predictable latency, not surprise overage.

carmen: +1 on per-tenant buckets. also we need autoscale safety nets: limit scale rate, and a preemption/grace window. Draft proto for autoscale config: ```autoscale: { min: 1, max: 50, scale_step: 4, cooldown_secs: 60 }``` We should also sample KV cache hit rates per-tenant to tune batching.

pete: from pilot customers (GenSys, Velox) — they expect a burst SLA we can sign: 99% of bursts should keep token latency < 300ms. Sales needs clear tier mapping to pricing. we can't leave this vague in contracts.

liz: CS input: if burst allocations are in contracts, CS must have a quick UI path to edit bursts + an audit trail. otherwise we'll get weekly support tickets. For pilots, one-off changes via CS is fine but needs automation behind it.

ajay: idea: short-lived emergency credits that CS or support can grant for 1 hour. implement as a soft-lease token bucket; credits decrement but have an expiry. low engineering cost and reduces manual intervention.

maria: scope question: do we launch console controls in MVP or CLI-only? My vote is CLI-only for MVP (faster), console in Phase 2. Need CS ok.

carmen: CLI-only MVP is fine if we emit audit events and provide a one-off CS endpoint for pilots. rollout plan recommendation: canary -> 5% tenants, then 25% after 24h, full after 72h if performance stable. fallback: automatic degrade to a smaller model variant when latency spikes.

pete: sales will push for console sooner, but we can trade: CLI MVP + CS-assisted UI for pilot customers (GenSys, Velox). they accept that for the initial contract if we show the canary plan and clear SLOs.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/dedicated-burst-v1 -> staging at 2024-06-15T18:00Z (build 0.23.4) :rocket:

maria: :thumbsup: Action items before tomorrow's sync: Ajay - prototype token-bucket + emergency-credit flow (owner). Carmen - autoscale guardrails + canary plan write-up. Liz - draft pilot CS runbook (how to grant credits, audit). Pete - draft contract language for burst SLA & tier pricing. I'll collate into a checklist and share.

ajay: On it. ETA EOD today for a prototype and perf numbers.

liz: I'll draft the runbook and include an escalation playbook for degraded-burst incidents.

maria: thanks everyone — we'll review checklist in sync tomorrow. if anyone can't make 11am ping me and we'll move.
